The '''Caarimoos system''' was a [[Star system/Legends|star system]] that was located in the [[Meridian sector/Legends|Meridian sector]], in the [[Outer Rim Territories/Legends|Outer Rim]]. The [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Caarimon]] was located in this system.
